deletion_rule: Delete only after graph reachability, reconstructability, and replay-plan validation all PASS.
may_cache_if_all: replay acceptance hash or invariant is known
no evidence claim requires the raw artifact specifically rather than its exact reconstruction
pin_if_any: not exactly reproducible from other retained/reconstructable nodes
frozen source/protocol/question needed to reproduce a certified run
formal/review decision that defines evidence scope
publication export explicitly promises standalone inclusion
promotion_rule: A checkpoint/cache becomes PINNED only if later evidence depends on its exact bytes and no exact reconstruction path exists.

CACHE.meaning: rebuildable derived artifact retained for convenience

CACHE_EXPENSIVE.meaning: rebuildable exactly but expensive enough to retain by default

EPHEMERAL.meaning: workspace/temp/checkpoint not needed after sealed stage unless it is the only available recovery path
